sampling.source: LAX default temperature 0.7 (config.temperature) on every turn as of 2026-09-19; Modelfile ships temperature 1, top_k 20, top_p 0.95, min_p 0, presence_penalty 1.5, repeat_penalty 1. Sampling per turn type is a Phase 2 experiment.

notes: Hand-written from the Phase 0 audit (docs/harness/AUDIT.md, 2026-09-19). Every value describes how LAX drives this model TODAY, so adopting the profile changes nothing; a field moves only through a logged experiment. Measured: native context 262,144; fully GPU-resident to 131,072 (24.8 GB); 262,144 spills (86% GPU, decode 74 -> 19.5 tok/s). Prefill ~3,634 tok/s, decode 71-77 tok/s at 65k with thinking off. /v1 thinks by default and LAX sends no reasoning control for this family (mode 'all' records that). tools + format together: no tool call, fabricated answer. Thinking levels accepted by the API, not honoured. Tier B = today's 'medium' (30 tools).
